A food item which restores {{Energy||20 -}} {{Energy||28}} and applies the 'Rage' buff when consumed. It must be made in the [[oven]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

===Effect===
On use, this {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} will apply the 'Rage' buff for a duration of 2 minutes, increasing the player's damage by {{Health|-|5}}. Quality level does not have an impact. For a list of all available buffs and their benefits, see [[effects]].
